data.value: This contract is made on {0} {1}, {2} in Thai Nguyen, Vietnam, between:

data.name: PartiesAgreement
data.value: Hereinafter referred to individually as 'Party' and collectively as 'Parties'. The Parties agree to sign this Agreement with the following terms and conditions:

data.name: Article1Content
data.value: 1.1. Party B agrees to provide Party A with access to the Platform Management System, allowing Party A to upload information, images, room rates, room availability status, and related policies of the Hotel to promote and sell accommodation services to end users ('Customers').\n1.2. Party A understands that Party B only operates as an intermediary platform connecting Hotels with Customers and is not responsible for the quality of services at Party A's premises.

data.name: Article2Content
data.value: 2.1. Provide accurate information: Party A is responsible for ensuring that all information uploaded to the Platform is accurate and continuously updated.\n2.2. Respect bookings: Party A must respect all bookings made by Customers through the Platform according to the published rates and policies.\n2.3. Best rate guarantee (Rate Parity): Party A commits that room rates published on the Platform will not be higher than rates published on any other online distribution channel, including the Hotel's own website.

data.name: Article3Content
data.value: 3.1. Party A agrees to pay Party B a commission fee of {0} (fifteen percent) on the final value of each successful booking (including taxes and other fees that the Customer must pay).\n3.2. On the 5th of each month, Party B will send Party A a detailed statement of completed bookings from the previous month and a commission invoice. Party A is responsible for paying the full amount on the invoice within 14 (fourteen) days of receiving the invoice.

data.name: Article4Content
data.value: 4.1. Each Party commits to comply with current regulations on personal data protection. Customer data provided by Party B may only be used by Party A for the purpose of completing bookings.\n4.2. The Parties agree to keep confidential the terms of this Agreement and all proprietary business information of the other Party.

data.name: Article5Content
data.value: 5.1. Any disputes arising from or related to this Agreement will first be resolved through negotiation and mediation.\n5.2. If disputes cannot be resolved through negotiation within 30 days, the dispute will be brought to the competent People's Court in Thai Nguyen, Vietnam. Vietnamese law applies.
